caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a rounded, open-back design and gently curved legs. The frame of the chair is rendered in shades of dark brown, suggesting a polished wood finish. The seat is upholstered and appears to be covered in a dark, possibly black or deep brown material, contrasting with the wooden frame. The chair’s front legs are slightly bowed outward, while the back legs are angled subtly backward. The surrounding background is a plain, light beige color, with no additional objects or detailing, focusing attention solely on the chair. Near the bottom right corner of the drawing, the name "Leroy Griffette" is written in small, simple capital letters.
title: Parlor Chair
